title: Inside a composite knitting mill
summary: Following the connected processes inside GMS Composite Knitting Ind. Ltd.
body:
An industrial visit to GMS Composite Knitting Ind. Ltd. in Gazipur offered a closer look at textile production beyond the classroom.

What I observed

The visit covered the mill’s production sections, including knitting and dyeing. Machinery included single jersey, double jersey, and Jacquard knitting machines.

The takeaway

Seeing connected production stages helps make sense of the relationship between fabric structure, processing, and the final product.
label: INDUSTRIAL VISIT · LEARNING EXPERIENCE
